name: matlab-import-export-data
description: Read or write data files in MATLAB. Use when the task involves tables, spreadsheets, delimited text, or structured files in CSV, Excel, Parquet, JSON, or XML format — including but not limited to importing, exporting, loading, parsing, converting, validating, configuring import options, reading from URLs, handling locales or encodings, diagnosing file errors, and modernizing legacy file I/O code. MATLAB provides built-in functions for these workflows with no additional products required.
